existing_group_assignments.rationale: Inhibition of the ERG voltage-gated potassium channel concerns the same channel as hERG blockade and IKr inhibition, but it is a distinct functional description that needs curator review.
Reduced hypothalamic GnRH is the same decreased-GnRH process, with different wording and specificity from the existing GnRH release events.
Reduced plasma LH is the same decreased-LH process as the LH surge and release events, but it lacks the anterior pituitary or surge context.

new_groups.rationale: Both concern alpha2u-globulin, but chemical binding in serum and accumulation in proximal tubular epithelium are distinct processes.
